def main():

        prog='executable',
        description='Make your i3 config a bit more stylish',
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog='''
USAGE:
    executable [FLAGS] [OPTIONS] [theme]

FLAGS:
    -h, --help        Prints help information
    -l, --list-all    Print a list of all available themes
    -r, --reload      Apply the theme by reloading the config
    -s, --save        Set the output file to the path of the input file
    -V, --version     Prints version information

OPTIONS:
    -c, --config <file>      The config file the theme should be applied to. Defaults to the default i3 location.
    -o, --output <file>      Apply the theme, attempt to validate the result, and write it to <file>
    -t, --to-theme <file>    Prints an i3-style theme based on the given config suitable for sharing with others
                             [default: ]

ARGS:
    <theme>    The theme to use
'''
    )
    
    parser.add_argument('-l', '--list-all', dest='list_all', action='store_true', help='Print a list of all available themes')
    parser.add_argument('-r', '--reload', dest='reload', action='store_true', help='Apply the theme by reloading the config')
    parser.add_argument('-s', '--save', dest='save', action='store_true', help='Set the output file to the path of the input file')
    parser.add_argument('-V', '--version', dest='version', action='store_true', help='Prints version information')

    if not os.path.exists(config_path):
        print("Could not find i3 config")
        return None
    
    with open(config_path, "r") as f:
        config_content = f.read()
    
    # Extract colors from bar section
    bar_match = re.search(r'bar\s*\{[^}]*colors\s*\{([^}]+)\}', config_content, re.DOTALL)
    if not bar_match:
        print("Could not find bar colors in config")
        return None
    
    colors = {}
    color_section = bar_match.group(1)
    
    # Parse separator
    sep_match = re.search(r'separator\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if sep_match:
        colors["separator"] = sep_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse background
    bg_match = re.search(r'background\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if bg_match:
        colors["background"] = bg_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse statusline
    status_match = re.search(r'statusline\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if status_match:
        colors["statusline"] = status_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse focused_workspace
    fw_match = re.search(r'focused_workspace\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if fw_match:
        colors["focused_workspace"] = fw_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse active_workspace
    aw_match = re.search(r'active_workspace\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if aw_match:
        colors["active_workspace"] = aw_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse inactive_workspace
    iw_match = re.search(r'inactive_workspace\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if iw_match:
        colors["inactive_workspace"] = iw_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse urgent_workspace
    uw_match = re.search(r'urgent_workspace\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if uw_match:
        colors["urgent_workspace"] = uw_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse client colors
    client_colors = {
        "client.focused": None,

        "client.urgent": None,
    }

    status_match = re.search(r'statusline\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if status_match:
        colors["statusline"] = status_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse focused_workspace
    fw_match = re.search(r'focused_workspace\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if fw_match:
        colors["focused_workspace"] = fw_match.group(1).strip()

    if aw_match:
        colors["active_workspace"] = aw_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse inactive_workspace
    iw_match = re.search(r'inactive_workspace\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if iw_match:
        colors["inactive_workspace"] = iw_match.group(1).strip()
    
    # Parse urgent_workspace
    uw_match = re.search(r'urgent_workspace\s+([^,\n]+)', color_section)
    if uw_match:
        colors["urgent_workspace"] = uw_match.group(1).strip()
